selection: First ranked K8 resource group, round 0 of the first BNN N/D/D/N pair; same eight ordered requests in all rows.
binding: New arms use one raw native root; replay of historic domain uses identical tree payload, packed netlist, placement, timing constraints, root endpoint vector and request. The per-arm placement pathname in route headers differs.
shared_control: The empty imported transaction verifies serialization once for the batch. All positive-weight trials use unrestricted routing and pressure retries. Domain is reused at zero new calls.
timing_boundary: Single serial imported batch on shared host, including control, searches, audits and output. This timer excludes initial routing, graph-cache creation, full adaptive re-selection, and terminal timing repair. No cross-configuration timing ratio.
